policy: No profiler; alternating sequential pairs; empty output and private compiled/registry caches; downloads excluded; OS page cache retained. RSS is the maximum individual process, not simultaneous worker memory.
lsp_sdk: Private ENCORE_HOME with library index symlinked to the same frozen package sources; the initial import_editing failure without this SDK was resolved by environment setup.
wine_harness: Resource-limited user service with a task-private Wine prefix; wrapper preserves the program exit status and stops only that prefix server before returning.
